findings.desc: CHK-002 adversarial verificationIntent explicitly requires repair to reject missing paths with config unchanged, but the recorded smoke coverage only exercises preview no-mutation, outside-path rejection, and nested non-root rejection. The implementation has a distinct missing-target branch at packages/main/src/handlers/lattice-cli.ts:605, while packages/main/src/tasks/field-regression-cli-smoke.ts:1014 and :1022 only cover ../outside and clawcreek/packages. Add a missing relative target assertion, e.g. setGitRoot="missing-creek" with confirm true, asserting non-zero exit, /target does not exist/, and unchanged config.
findings.resolvedReason: Resolved by d7b106e: validateRepairGitRootTarget now performs lexical containment before existence checks and canonical realpath containment only for existing targets, so missing relative children under /var metadata roots report target does not exist instead of unsafe path. Verified with npm --prefix packages/main run build, node packages/main/dist/tasks/field-regression-cli-smoke.js, and node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs.
